notes.title: Christmas gift – finally Steam Keys for BM11 bundle!
notes.notes:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/12/bemine_keys.jpg[/img]

Hi people,

for the [b]love of our game[/b] and the hope that most of you will appreciate that, we decided to make a Christmas gift to all buyers of BM11, by providing them a Steam key for [b]The Body Changer (via Groupees website).[/b]

Even if our game was only a [b]BONUS[/b] with Desura keys in BM11, some bundle buyers do not ask the steam keys because part it, but to [b]kindly[/b] advise us that giving the Steam keys could increase the visibility of the game and expand the amount of people who can play [b]The Body Changer[/b].

We've been persuaded: they could be right, let's call it a "reasonable marketing move" :)

We will let you know as soon as possible when Groupees staff will publish the keys in their site.
Take care and have a nice XMas.

Ciao,
Alessio & ALberto - [b]TSATT[/b]

notes.title: Fumetti per Gioco 2015 fair
notes.notes:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-21-20-10-47.jpg[/img]
Hi all!
Last week end we were at Trieste for the Fumetti per Gioco 2015 fair.
We had an amazing times with all the people that we knew and played THE BODY CHANGER - a lot of congratulations and very good comments.
Some pics:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-22-14-37-16.jpg?w=768[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-21-17-59-19.jpg?w=1024[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-21-17-14-09.jpg?w=1024[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-22-15-48-01.jpg?w=1024[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-22-15-07-50.jpg?w=1024[/img]

We had also the opportunity to speak with the youTuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/victorlaszlo88]Victorlaszlo88[/url] which is a VERY nice person and liked a lot our game.
He played TBC on Saturday and came back on Sunday asking us to play again... Isn't that cool? ^_^

Some pics about him:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-22-11-39-07.jpg[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-21-20-11-02.jpg[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-21-20-10-47.jpg[/img]

On Sunday we also met Andrea "Bisboch" Babich which I'm a fan from the [url=http://www.outcast.it/category/podcast/podaudio/soundshower/]Outcast Soundshowser podcast[/url] (occasionally on the youTube channel from [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYnEJtArnQe7vZyODCi06oQ]Fabio Bortolotto[/url]). We spoke about a lot of things that are game related, developing problems and stuff.. was quite amazing and he was very impressed by TBC.

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-22-16-16-36.jpg?w=1024[/img]

So, it was a very nice week end and TKS SO MUCH to all the people that came playing and speaking with us.
And final pic with the fair staff and other devs:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/2015-11-22-19-39-11.jpg[/img]

And what about new games? ;) We are currently on a terrain editor for our next title... take a look:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/screenshot_0006.jpg[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/screen01.jpg[/img]

 

All still made with Python and Ogre3D, of course. More info in the future ;)

That's all for today. Take care and have some nice plays,

ALba - TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: Game over 2015
notes.notes:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-18-44-34.jpg?w=660[/img]

Hi all!

Last week end we were at the [url=https://www.facebook.com/gameovermilano]Game Over 2015[/url] (Milan) and it was quite fun.
We had many great gamers at our location, knows nice persons that were interested in the flair and some other devs.
Some pics, take a look:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-18-44-29.jpg?w=300[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-13-19-16.jpg?w=300[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-19-16-08.jpg?w=300[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-14-49-16.jpg?w=300[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-15-48-26.jpg?w=300[/img]

and here's our youngest champion that made it to level 2: [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-15-10-02.jpg?w=660[/img]

He didn't even read texts, just follow his instinct ;) AMAZING.
We also gave away some cards:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/cardsynb03dart.png?w=200[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/cardhope12.png?w=200[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/cardsynb01ighel.png?w=200[/img] 
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/cardsynb02dummy.png?w=200[/img]

After the fair we spoke a lot about how the people has played the game and the challenge of the first sector.
So we decided to add a camera move on the first use of the activator to be sure everyone understand what to do, a bit more.

In current version we have other fixes:
[list]
	[*]click on the options highest border doesn't close anymore the options[/*]
	[*]better cut scene on first water colour change, without the problem of pressing the action button and change SynBs at the same time[/*]
	[*]better shader on taken d-Disks[/*]
	[*]first enemies in Sector-01 give more ammo when killed, so no more risk to be without ammo on Sector-02[/*]
	[*]the kebre is easy to kill on Sector- on level easy and normal, with longer scream animation and less energy[/*]
[/list]
You can play right now with all that stuff right now.
With the localization we are on SP, FR and DE, it will take more time but it's coming out.

That's all for the news, take care and have fun until next week!

TheShortAndTheTall

 [h1]MAIN GAME MODE is COMPLETE. HELL YEAH, dammit![/h1]

	[*]We are completing the [b]IT localization[/b], it's taking a lot of time, more then expected sadly... then we will move on with other languages, at least that's the plan. Alessio fixed all the bugs of the editor and added some features for knowing which sentence was changed and a better backup system.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_editorlangnew.jpg?w=660[/img]
[list]
	[*]With the arenas, we have right now [b]3 new[/b] and playable but [b]for the week end[/b] I think we will have ALL ready. We have added new names (that give an idea of what's going on..) and changed the weapons list and specs, for making them great experience, let's hope you will love them. We reduced the map size, so you can see more icons on screen and planing your moves .[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip01.jpg?w=660[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip02.jpg?w=660[/img] 

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip03.jpg?w=660[/img]
[list]
	[*]On the [b]ALTERED SIGNAL[/b] arenas we recalculate the [b]noise[/b] effect, it will start sooner but with less.. noise and become stronger with a better progression. In the previous version it started late and strong and we were not completely satisfied with it .[/*]

[list]
	[*][b]Throwing bombs[/b] now is a bit faster, it takes less time[/*]
	[*]We have some new in game [b]E-mails from NO-END[/b] that introduce the player a bit more to the gameplay, with a bit of infos about the SynBs and the Activator. We decided it could be a good idea after a friend of mine (from UK) played the game and told us his impressions.[/*]

Have great time and take care.

TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: 16 DAYS TO ULTRA EDITION!
notes.notes:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/04/tbc_ultra.jpg?w=660[/img]

We take some time but finally we want to show you the super new version of TBC, called [b]ULTRA[/b]. Here is it:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/04/tbc_ultra_01.jpg[/img]

Because people that follow Indie project usually prefer [b]2D pixel graphics like old 16-bit era[/b], we switch our engine to a 2D version that can handle pixel like hell! Real time lighting, fake prospective management, more then 10 layers of parallax, real time reflection.. [b]2D as its best[/b]!
The gameplay changes a bit but there is still the SynB switch mechanic: you will use the [b]Ighel in the main layer [/b]and, by pressing right trigger or left trigger + X and left/right/up/down on D-Pad, you can bring in front the other SynBs and do some special moves. Take a look:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/04/tbc_ultra_03.jpg[/img]
 
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/04/tbc_ultra_02.jpg?w=640[/img]

GREAT STUFF!

We hope you like it as we do! We used to love sooo many GREAT 2D adventures like, for example, ALIENS:INFESTATION for DS and we think this is the right new direction for TBC.

Fuck 3D, this is the future!
Tell your friend and come back, in 16 days [b]you will finally try the new BETA[/b]!

ps. max resolution is 640x480 BUT of course we handle HD by stretching pixels.

notes.notes:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_sect08final_00.jpg?w=660[/img]

Last week you saw the new Sector-08 with screens from first part, today we want to show you some new progress.

Thanks to more testing the first part that you saw changed a bit. We [b]removed a[/b] [b]collectable key [/b]because it was useless, on gameplay side, [b]re-ordered some invisible triggers[/b] and [b]balanced the enemy-groups spawn order again[/b]. Why [b]again[/b]? We decided to introduce here a [b]new bonus[/b] for the [b]Ighel[/b] SynB because the action oriented direction of the puzzles was sometimes a bit frustrating with the characters change, during the enemies attack. This is one of the common case where you think and design a game situation with all the details in mind (time, single action duration, rooms size, stuff inside...) and then, when you finally build it, you find out that something didn't work that much as expected. But with the new bonus the situation flips and we must say that it really kick ass and it's amazing how nice the multiple SynB use works now, while under attack!

On the [b]first major puzzle[/b] we make the [b]introduction[/b] more intuitive and added on a "[b]special zone[/b]" some graphical hints, so it should be clear for the player what to do and we change a bit last part that was in some way [u][u]skippable[/u][/u] in the first version. The [b]following puzzles[/b] changed with the [b]elements timing[/b] and the [b]enemy numbers[/b] and were [b]adapt in some parts with the new bonus in mind[/b]. The final result is really very well balanced: you should now fell that if something didn't work and you die, it's your fault and not the game, you just need to try a better strategy or find a better way to defend and solve.

Here's today screenshots, updated first part:

notes.title: Polishing Sector-08
notes.notes:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_finalsect08_02r.jpg?w=660[/img]

[b]Sector-08![/b] As told in last news, last week we were on [b]Sector-08[/b].
The map has changed a bit more and the final result, in 3D, is this with some restyle and resize:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_finalsect08_01r1.jpg?w=660[/img]

And now let's focus on the gameplay side: the sector is divided in different zones with different things to do but it's more or less all around protecting each other while solving the puzzles and trying to reach the level end for purify the water.
The nice thing is that the "[u]danger situation[/u]" change in any zone, so you need to pay attention to the rooms details and find the right attack/defend/use-stuff strategy - to summarize: [b]strategy is the key[/b]. :)

With the gameplay we still need to complete last 3 rooms because we played many times the current places for [b]polishing the gameplay[/b] and that takes a lot of time: we reduced the number of enemies, changed some timer duration and added some invisible triggers for balancing the re-spawn and [b]avoid at any cost frustration[/b]. It's possible that, at the end, the level will be one with the highest number of deads (maybe.. that's my prediction ;) ) but in a good way - you know, the situation where you die because your fault and not because the game bad design.

We introduced also a camera variation for solving a puzzle that we enjoyed a lot, it works very well and the final result makes us very happy even because we changed many little details with the intent to make it as funny as possible.
Some screenshot:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_sector08_06.png?w=660[/img]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_sector08_04.png[/img]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_sector08_00.png?w=660[/img]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_sector08_07.png?w=660[/img]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_sector08_03.png?w=660[/img]

So, what's next from the [u]toDo[/u] list? We will making the [b]environments more rich[/b], [b]complete and balance the rooms[/b] and then we will continue with the [b]gameplay[/b] of the [b]final zones[/b] of Sector-08.
Next week there will be some new updates and then it will be [b]time for Sector-09[/b] - so time for a preview with a [b]piece of the map[/b], enjoy:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_s09-map.jpg[/img]

Tks for reading and please share to your friends and all gamers you know!

TheShortAndTheTall

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/03/tbc_sect08_wip_3.jpg?w=660[/img]Hi people!
Previously on TBC ^_^ : [b]Sector-07 is almost done[/b] . Almost because but we need to change some stuff for the Sectors exploration order - some new area needs special objs/ability so we must be sure that the player don't get stuck and that he can come back to previous Sectors with any problems.

But today's update it's all about [b]Sector-08[/b] so let's go into it!
Last announcement had a [b]preview from the map [/b]but[b] i[/b]t was [b]changed a bit in the final part[/b]. Now there is [b]different area[/b], with different art style, and [b]better and nicer puzzles[/b]. 
The zone was initially set between some kind of mountains with bridges to turn but the gameplay didn't convince us that much and could have been a bit tedious. 
We took an old idea we liked a lot and that was waiting for the right moment, altered it and made it fit in the Sector. So: no more mountains, no more bridges but some new stuff to do for surviving and continuing the mission that we are sure you will like ;) .

Now that's the current Sector-08 map:

This sector is very long and is more or less divided in 3 zones. 
The 3D envs are in developing and I think next week we will have the final model with maybe a different color palette + more or less all game scripts done with a completely playable area, from the begin to the end.

notes.title: New ALPHA! Survive the 3 new ARENA MODES!
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/324390/][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/killthemall_w1000.jpg?w=799[/img][/url]

A new and [b]HUGE [/b]update is finally available with a lot of nice things and a most of all: the [b]3 NEW GAME MODES [/b]are finally available!

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_themodes.png?w=800[/img]

To unlock the menu with the [b]Arena Modes [/b]you need to [b]finish sector 1 [/b](so you will have reached the minimum of combat knowledge). After this you will be able to play with the [b]first area [/b]- we will add [b]more and more areas [/b]in the future alphas.  

Any mode is about [b]fighting [/b]and [b]surviving [/b]but has a [b]unique game mechanic[/b] with a special set of [b]custom weapons[/b], so it's not simple shot-or-die (and use and abuse of the combos for making points) but you need to follow the mission and kill as many as possible enemies (by making combos!). 
Because the [b]Arena Modes [/b]  were born for having great time in fast plays and make more points as possible we will add soon [b]STEAM LEADERBOARDS[/b]. So, train now as much as possible :D

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_killgrott.jpg?w=800[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_killorbekilled.jpg?w=800[/img]

But the update is not only about this, so here is our current development change log: 

[list][*][b]UPDATED HUD[/b] [b]ICONS[/b]: the objects icons are now [b]brighter [/b]with a [b]stronger stroke around [/b]and we fixed also a Z-index "bug" where the icons were drawn BEHIND instead of in front of the selector. 
[/*][*][b]UPDATED HUD[/b] [b]SELECTOR [/b]and [b]TABS[/b]: elements are now all blue with less alpha for better contrast and the selector in particular is completely new, with a nicer and more modern design 
[/*][*][b]DIFFICULTY OPTION [/b]is no more available from the option menu - when you will start a new game you will also choose the difficulty level[/*][*][b]NEW GUI ELEMENTS[/b]: we have made a new group of elements for the in-game pop-ups that we will include asap.[/*][*][b]GAME TEXTS [/b]are now all into an unique file, from menu to game text to story - you know, order is always better ;) [/*][/list][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_hud.jpg?w=800[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_weaponsright.jpg?w=662[/img]

Next to come: [b]include Sector 6 [/b]in current story mode, insert the [b]leaderboards [/b]in the 3 new game mode, add the new GUI elements and continue with Sector 7.

So, let's hope you will [b]hear the applause [/b](???) when you will playing the new game modes, have a lot of fun and please comment if you have suggestions or just if you like it.
Please also spread the word and, if you have a [b]Facebook account[/b], why don't you [url=https://www.facebook.com/theshortandthetall][b]follow us[/b][/url]? 

Until next time take care and have a great time,

  TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: 17 hours to EARLY ACCESS!
notes.notes:
Hi people!
Tomorrow is finally release time on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/324390/]EARLY ACCESS for THE BODY CHANGER![/url]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/capsule_main3.jpg[/img]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/324390/]DIRECT LINK HERE[/url]

First of all tks to all the players that has helped us to make current version very stable and that has posted comments and suggestions.
TBC has now [b]5 completely sectors/levels[/b] fully playable with all the puzzles and action moments. 
We introduce some new things with the last updates, after reading what players has to say:

 [list]
    [*] [b]Text hints on screen while loading[/b] - this should be really helpful for a better game experience
    [*] [b]New weapon change shortcut[/b]: not only we support the mouse wheel but also the keyboard numbers, as asked from many users
    [*] [b]New menu shortcut[/b]: click more times the INVENTORY BUTTON for switching between in-game menu tabs
    [*] Some new [b]INFO DEVICES[/b] in some the puzzle rooms - so, you won't get stuck ;)
[/list] 

During the period on EARLY ACCESS we will continue with the improvements, we will complete and end the [b]other 5 levels[/b], create [b]new achievements[/b], introduce the [b]collectable artifacts[/b] (in all the levels) for increasing the replay value and make it more satisfying.
We would like to end and complete the final game at the [b]beginning of 2015[/b], let's say [b]Febrary[/b].

Also [b]the cards are coming[/b], sadly I'm late on this even if 3 are done and also a lot [b]emoticons are complete[/b] (we just need to choose which one to use).

  TheShortAndTheTall
